PR332.body:
#307 D1 closes old dispatches and prepares a new six-target candidate after the host CLI fix. Candidate15/v25 remains BLOCKED_PREWINDOW_REVIEW with its heartbeat PAUSED; all old authorizations, failure evidence, budgets and pins are retained.

The fixed CLI resolves `--group` through `Host.group` before `archive_root` or `revoke_case`. Frozen candidate16/v26 binds execution `aa2605a5-1fcf-4e9d-b6f2-8f5b13321b8a` and the authorized 2026-10-20 18:00–18:40 Singapore window. Its only targets are P2→T1→T2→H2A→M1A→M1B, once each and six globally; P1 stays excluded and all 11 survivors stay protected.

Non-delete preparation: Python normal/-O each 34 methods; Go 274 PASS / 2 explicit SKIP. Actual three-source Core fingerprints and ACLs stayed unchanged. All 17 versions, 23 known IAM identities plus 9 absent names, 9 new backups, independent clean/rehearsal/native restores and four business rehearsals passed. Twenty old fact multisets were preserved. Frozen offline validation and the complete preparation read-only entry passed; the latter recorded 113 technical request pairs and closed its owners. Technical requests and rehearsal CostEvents remain separate; amount is NOT_ASSESSED. The bounded independent preparation review passed with no remaining blockers.

Actual window outcome: FAILED_OFFLINE_AUDIT_SEALED_NO_DELETE. At the start of the authorized window, the extra host audit script incorrectly read the independent evidence index as a `members` list; its actual schema is a `files` map. The KeyError occurred before the frozen complete native preflight, source startup or any enable/send operation. All six targets are NOT_RUN; physical DELETE attempts, provider invocations, case/sender/wire/recovery starts and signing are zero. This is an execution-composition error, not an established inventory or candidate invariant failure. It was not patched and retried in the window.

The fixed seal ran all 103 steps. Fresh physical readback confirms 445 stopped/PID0/noports/norestart CIDs, 30 false permissions, 6 revoked cases and 6 revoked recovery profiles, 3 stopped/sealed gateways, 3 empty new budgets and 9 matching new backups. Since native services stayed stopped, all three disable-all steps could not produce a fresh IAM readback: overall containment is UNCONFIRMED, despite confirmed physical/local closure and a zero CLI exit code. All original errors and pre/post facts remain. The same heartbeat is now PAUSED with no next run; the execution has an immutable terminal record and its authorization cannot be reused.

Exact publication HEAD remains `74aa674db18dd68966d070e9f04173bb37ad1a7c`, with fresh run 39359998615 event=pull_request 13/13 SUCCESS and zero review threads at window start. Source `5472a583f86838df42a5ffd86bc366c166036efb` has separate source CI 39356719557. These are PR CI, not main CI, provider execution or full D1 acceptance. No tracked source, candidate, binary or frozen public evidence was modified; only authorized private fail-closure revocations were applied.

Full bindings and historical preparation are in `docs/acceptance/issue307-d1-candidate16-confirmation.md`, `issue307-d1-v26-window-runbook.md` and `issue307-d1-v26-preparation.md`. New authorization/scheduling snapshots remain immutable. Actual outcome and remaining work are in `docs/acceptance/issue307-d1-v26-window01-outcome.md` and `delete-confirmed-v26-execution01/window01/`.

The follow-up is to put index verification into a fixed tested entry covering the real files-map and members-list contracts, then exercise the complete success composition before any future execution proposal. No new candidate or schedule was created. cleanup=0, hold-release=0, bypass=0. #332 stays Draft and unmerged, #307 stays OPEN, and full D1 remains NOT_ACCEPTED.
